body.x: Every building already has a grid of wiring running to its light fixtures, reaching every room. Using that existing network to run a building's systems, instead of laying new cable, saves a second installation.
Merlotlab.INC was named a 2027 Honoree in Enterprise Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the Merlot Building DX Platform.

The Merlot Building DX Platform is a digital-transformation platform that integrates an Energy Management System and a Real-Time Location System through a building's lighting infrastructure, built on Merlot Mesh, Merlot Lab's proprietary wireless mesh technology.

Merlot EMS creates a building-wide wireless network through lighting fixtures fitted with mesh communication modules; a single Gateway can connect up to 2,000 lighting fixtures, sensors and IoT devices, and by controlling energy-intensive systems such as lighting and HVAC it delivers energy savings from the first day of operation. Merlot RTLS adds UWB Anchors to the same lighting infrastructure, enabling real-time monitoring of workers, equipment and mobile assets without a separate network or additional wiring.

By operating EMS and RTLS on one infrastructure, the platform reduces duplicate deployment costs and enables phased expansion from energy management and location-based services toward a broader range of smart-building solutions.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
